evidence.summary: Distill documents into structured skills with indexed rules and provenance.
Provide concept-level planner, routing, reflection, memory, and evaluation patterns.
Prefer concise numbered action-first communication without tangents.
Apply editing and self-check rules to avoid generic output.
Support model-agnostic tooling and multi-provider integration.
Separate source claims from AI interpretation and preserve citations.
Keep sources as reusable first-class assets for research workflows.
Combine keyword research, clustering, intent, and competitive analysis.
Use recon, discovery, validation, remediation, rescan, and reporting.
